notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Today marks one month since I released Slime Pandemic TD! Sales and reception have massively exceeded expectations, so I'd like to give you all big [b]thank you[/b]. If you have been able to play the game, I would love for you to leave a review on the game's steam page.

I post updates regarding this game or any future games on my Twitter, so if you're interested, please follow me here: [url=https://twitter.com/Tornellll][b]https://twitter.com/Tornellll[/b][/url] (Updates and patch notes about this game will still be announced on the game's steam hub, as usual.)

Again, thank you so much, and have a nice weekend!

[i]Kind regards,
Christoffer Tornell[/i]

notes.title: Patch Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello! Here's a patch with both some balance changes and bug fixes.

Balance changes: [list]
[*]5-2 Guyana Cape: [i]This mission proved to be very difficult, and thus caused frustration for a lot of players. It is a very unique mission, as gold is constantly trickling down. With the changes for this mission, the uniqueness of it stays while allowing it to be beaten by a wider range of strategies than before.[/i]
[list]
[*]Waves 8-13 now have less high health enemies and more lower health enemies. 
[*]There are now [b]EMP Bots[/b] present in the mission.
[*]Gold trickles down every [b]1.35 seconds[/b] instead of every [b]1.5 seconds[/b].
[*]There are now more nodes available in hard mode on this mission.
[/list][/list]
Bug fixes: [list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the achievement for clearing every level in hard mode sometimes wouldn't be registered.
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't create a hard mode save file after getting all stars.
[/list]

Have a nice day!

Kind Regards,
Christoffer Tornell

notes.title: Patch Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope you're enjoying the game. Some bugs were still in the game, so here's an update that should fix these. [i] I've updated Slime Pandemic TD to version 1.01. 
[/i]
Save data:[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't create a hard mode save file after getting all stars and then closing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't earn bonus stars from getting all stars on each world after starting a new save file.
[/list]
I've also gotten some feedback about the raised difficulty of some select levels, and will be taking this into account for the next patch update.

Have a nice day!

[i]Kind Regards,
Christoffer Tornell[/i]
